title: Shore Me The Way | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked away at the end of a quiet street in the exclusive Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, Shore Me the Way is a modern retreat designed for unforgettable 30A getaways. This beautifully crafted four-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bath home comfortably sleeps ten and features four private king suites plus a cozy bunk nook. With its refined coastal décor, open-concept living spaces, and a serene screened-in porch, it offers the perfect balance of privacy and togetherness. Every detail, from the luxe furnishings to the pet-friendly accommodations, sets the stage for effortless comfort. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property.
